title: Saint Isaac cathedral, five domes and four porticos
visualBrief: Saint Isaac cathedral principal exterior: mapped central body/four corner pylons, four granite-columned pediment porticos with two column rows, real primary recessed arched doorway/threshold, colonnaded drum/clerestory, ribbed gilded main dome/lantern/cross and four open belfries/smaller gilded domes. Shared pale limestone, rose granite, painted-metal gold substitute, patinated copper and opaque glazing. Preserve all independent buildings and original roads/water. Historic sculpture, lettering, interior/operating religious fixtures and exact reliefs are omitted or abstracted.
